packageRules.description: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component is pinned per interpreter to the newest Home Assistant each can run, measured by scripts/ha_matrix.py and gated by its pre-commit hook. One version for every marker would break that, so Renovate leaves it (and homeassistant) alone.
manifest.json pins pypowerpetdoor exactly and pyproject.toml floors it at the same version; they move together in one PR.
